invocation.transport: local deterministic renderer + OAR runtime parser

coverage.description: Source-pinned author-config baseline for OAR root metadata and submod name/priority/conditions plus selected parser-backed submod settings.
known_gaps: condition-specific argument schemas are not yet modeled; only the condition discriminator is typed and remaining condition payload is source-shaped
variants, condition presets, functions and user.json overrides are not generated by this baseline
HKX authoring/copying is a separate asset pipeline
coverage.denominator_probe: declared submods vs generated config.json files vs OAR parsed/active submods and runtime animation selections.

safety.sandbox_or_scope: Writes only declared author config.json paths beneath the supplied output directory; rejects absolute/traversal submod paths.

verification.output_readback: Require generated JSON parse, OAR load evidence, and positive/negative animation-selection fixtures for release claims.

ai.context_cost_notes: Deterministic bridge from animation replacement intent to OAR author configs while leaving condition-specific schemas explicit future work.

evidence.notes: Parsing.cpp verifies required mod/submod names, required submod priority, optional settings, conditions and pairedConditions; ReplacerMods.cpp verifies author serialization field names.
